messages:
Jordan: Heads-up: reconciliation jobs started failing in payments-prod post-entitlement sweep. KMS decrypt permission denied. @Sam any context?
Sam: Yep, recon job logs show `PermissionDenied: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter missing for recon-sa`. Sweep removed a group binding for the key.
Maria: We scoped admin roles in the least-priv run last night and intended to keep a small exception list for production KMS keys. Looks like that exception didn't apply.
Lina: Confirmed sweeper applied RBAC patch at 02:12 UTC (patch eq-2026-03-04T02:12). It deleted bindings on payments/recon-key.
DevOpsBot: Incident INC-2026-0324-88 created: "payments-recon KMS decrypt failures" 0eng-oncall.
Jordan: Short fix: re-add cryptoKeyDecrypter for recon service account and validate decrypts. Sam, service account id?
Sam: recon-sa@redwood-prod. Grant command: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding recon-key --location global --keyring payments --member serviceAccount:recon-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
Lina: I'll test in staging then apply to prod, will post audit entry.
Sam: After Lina's regrant: `2026-03-24T02:30:15Z recon: decrypt OK for 1024 msgs`. Jobs resumed.
Jordan: Action items: 1) Lina 5 apply regrant + add rollback runbook and alert for KMS decrypt error spike. 2) Maria 5 update sweep config so keys marked service-critical are never automatically pruned; add pre-sweep usage query (30d). 3) Sam 5 add recon-key to temporary exception list until sweep gating is live. 4) Jordan 5 change sweeper to produce proposed patches + review queue for first 2 weeks after rollout.
OncallBot: INC-2026-0324-88 resolved at 02:35 UTC.
Maria: I'll own the gating PR and tests, ETA EOD tomorrow.
Sam: Filed SEC-3287 on the security board: "entitlement-sweep: KMS safe-guarding".
Lina: Will post PR links here when available.
Jordan: Good triage, closing thread once PRs linked.
